description: Generated caller fence, extended by the organization preset in Verjson/renovate-config (#1812). Adopters' generated callers are byte-exact generator output, so Renovate must not edit them; their action pins and runner labels move in Verjson/.github's generators and reach an adopter only when it regenerates. scripts/ci-gate/renovate-generated-callers.test.py derives this path list from the generators.

packageRules.description: Generator-owned caller paths whose output carries a dependency the github-actions manager would update: release.yml (gen-changelog-caller.sh release-node, release-artifact, release-snapshot), any extra release caller an adopter names release-<purpose>.yml (the generated contract test accepts a release caller under any name), and changelog-contract.yml (pr-gate). Other generated callers reference only Verjson/.github workflows, whose digest updates the organization preset already disables. Renovate cannot match a file by its generated header, so the fence matches by path: a hand-written workflow on one of these paths is fenced too and must be reopened by its own repository (ADR 0232).
